dataList.dlg: ... Ah, I gotta talk into the mic now? ... But why? ... Cheer them on? Okay. Woo, you can do it...!
I'm always so... hungry... But all of that goes away when I'm watching you. Why's that?
Strangers, your clothes are turning redder and redder... Just like the Rouges' clothes. ... Are you becoming my followers?
Are you... sighing? But isn't sighing for when you're— Ohh... You're all tired...
They're all reeling... Are they... hurting?

Why aren't you moving? Mm... Your legs hurt?
... Okay. I don't like waiting, but... I'll wait for you.
They can't move anymore when they're dead...? But why...? No, no. They're gonna rise again... I don't want it to end like that.
Ah, they've stopped moving. Mm... But they're also not in pain anymore. I'm sure we'll meet back at the Fount soon.
... One by one, they fall and stop moving. When that happens to everyone... will I be all alone?

They're bleeding all over... while you're comfortably cutting them into smaller pieces...
... Oh, is this what "renovation" means?
Whoa. I really didn't expect that... Wow... You strangers are really strong.

Looks like... It'll all end soon. And when it does... I'm worried I'll be left alone...
I want everyone to stay with me after the end.
... Splashing and cresting like tall waves... Something's gonna burst out soon. ... Maybe you should get out of the way?
Ah, I know this. It's a "game," right? Where a buncha people set rules and play together. Lemme join, lemme join.
That made a pleasant sound, like slicing clean through the flesh...
... I dunno if you can see me, but I have my hands up. I wanna ask another question... Why did you do that?
The one who used to sing to me... said clothes made of good leather make a pleasant sound when you move around in them... I think she was right.
That made a disturbing sound, like applying too much pressure on leather... I don't like it.

They look full of energy, like they just ate a whole bunch of something. Weird, I didn't see them put anything in their mouths...
... Is there another way of consuming other than eating?
They look hungry... Feebly-sickly, wibbly-wobbly... Now I'm hungry, too.
... If you had snacks, why didn't you share with me?

You're all in a bad mood... Are you hungry? Hmm, I don't have anything to share...
... Now I'm hungry, too.
Ah, something fell off. Did it get... "cooked"? Like Wriggley?
Is that not... food? Why isn't anybody eating that? If nobody wants it... Then I'll eat it.
That looks... painful. Pain's no good.
I don't want you guys to get hurt. You strangers don't follow my Voice, but... you listen to me. So please don't hurt yourselves.
Keep moving forward, just like that. I have to keep climbing.
They've all... fallen like the setting sun, right? But... it had to happen. If they hadn't... it would've been you guys instead.
Everything's fallen... like cleaning a dish and moving on to the next. ... So that's your way of doing things, too.
It's over. Let's keep climbing. ... You'll stay with me up there too, right?
... Don't worry. You'll rise again.
*tap* *tap* What's this? ... Mmkay. I gotta be the Voice, right? My name is... Pwie. I think I'm Pwie. Can you hear my voice?
